## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and why it is needed.

## Verification

- Commands run and outcomes:
- Checks skipped or not run (with reasons):
- Runtime/Skill changes: versioned wheel and mirror validation:

## Publication and safety

- [ ] Examples and logs contain no credentials or customer information.
- [ ] Sanitized records are labeled; failures and skipped tests remain visible.
- [ ] Compatibility/performance claims match the checks actually run.
- [ ] External data flow and permission changes are documented.
- [ ] No human approval, required test, or completion gate is bypassed.

For vulnerabilities, use the reporting instructions in SECURITY.md instead of public details.
